changes.description: MCP OAuth sign-in in classic and Rust V2 now works with servers that require an issuer
[V3] `/memories` configures memory access and automatic updates for local sessions
V2 TUI hook matchers such as `read` cover more tools, widening any matching blocking hooks
V2 TUI tool hooks receive `tool_tags` so scripts can check a tool's group
[V3] `kiro-cli acp` uses your CLI login unless you pass `--auth-method=client`
[V3] Custom agents use their tool settings to decide which `mcp.json` servers to start
[V3] Stdio MCP servers now inherit the full agent environment
Classic `fs_write` no longer auto-approves symlink writes outside `allowedPaths`
Model fallback changes take effect in the current session without restarting
MCP OAuth now shows the authorization URL so you can open it from SSH or tmux sessions
[V3] Non-interactive runs respect `telemetry.enabled` and `KIRO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY`
[V3] `/upgrade-agent` rewrites legacy hook matchers such as `fs_read` so they fire on V3
Knowledge search limits apply across all bases, with combined pagination and file-type filtering
[V3] Sessions no longer unexpectedly close under heavy load
[V3] Custom agents dispatched as subagents now load their own `mcpServers`
[V3] Effort selector is offered at session start for an effort-capable default model
[V3] Images are resized to fit the selected model instead of failing the request
[V3] `KIRO_API_KEY` keys minted outside `us-east-1` now authenticate in their home region
[V3] Readable retry message when the backend returns a non-JSON error page
[V3] Resumed sessions keep `UserPromptSubmit` hook output in the conversation
[V3] Stop now cancels a prompt sent while MCP servers are still starting
[V3] A prompt sent just as a turn ends now includes that turn in the model's history
[V3] Manual steering files now load even when their slash command appears mid-prompt
